\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 273-276 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R281-first-pass-words-from-chapters-273-276}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for that is and especially.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to pick up, to sow, to peck, to spin, to pinch
  \item a swelling, a sprain, a fracture, a burn, diabetes
  \item boredom, a lump, a bruise, jaundice, blood pressure
  \item always, regularly, often, usually, rarely
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To pick up? (\textbf{\ml{പെറുക്കുക}}, \emph{peṟukkuka}.) To sow? (\textbf{\ml{വിതയ്ക്കുക}}, \emph{vitaykkuka}.) To peck? (\textbf{\ml{കൊത്തുക}}, \emph{kottuka}.) To spin? (\textbf{\ml{കറങ്ങുക}}, \emph{kaṟaṅṅuka}.) To pinch? (\textbf{\ml{നുള്ളുക}}, \emph{nuḷḷuka}.) A swelling? (\textbf{\ml{നീര്}}, \emph{nīrŭ}.) A sprain? (\textbf{\ml{ഉളുക്ക്}}, \emph{uḷukkŭ}.) A fracture? (\textbf{\ml{ഒടിവ്}}, \emph{oṭivŭ}.) A burn? (\textbf{\ml{പൊള്ളൽ}}, \emph{poḷḷal}.) Diabetes? (\textbf{\ml{പ്രമേഹം}}, \emph{pramēhaṁ}.) Boredom? (\textbf{\ml{ബോറടി}}, \emph{bōraṭi}.) A lump? (\textbf{\ml{മുഴ}}, \emph{muḻa}.) A bruise? (\textbf{\ml{ചതവ്}}, \emph{catavŭ}.) Jaundice? (\textbf{\ml{മഞ്ഞപ്പിത്തം}}, \emph{maññappittaṁ}.) Blood pressure? (\textbf{\ml{രക്തസമ്മർദ്ദം}}, \emph{raktasammarddaṁ}.) Always? (\textbf{\ml{എപ്പോഴും}}, \emph{eppōḻuṁ}.) Regularly? (\textbf{\ml{പതിവായി}}, \emph{pativāyi}.) Often? (\textbf{\ml{പലപ്പോഴും}}, \emph{palappōḻuṁ}.) Usually? (\textbf{\ml{മിക്കപ്പോഴും}}, \emph{mikkappōḻuṁ}.) Rarely? (\textbf{\ml{അപൂർവമായി}}, \emph{apūrvamāyi}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 277-281 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R281-second-pass-words-from-chapters-277-281}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for an auspicious moment and an anniversary.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item an auspicious moment, an anniversary, nowadays, on that day, meanwhile
  \item a bend, a traffic signal, traffic, a building, a district
  \item a sports ground, a museum, a gym, a valley, a desert
  \item a region, the land around a house, a slope, a sacred grove, a lane
  \item moreover, besides, for example, that is, especially
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
An auspicious moment? (\textbf{\ml{മുഹൂർത്തം}}, \emph{muhūrttaṁ}.) An anniversary? (\textbf{\ml{വാർഷികം}}, \emph{vārṣikaṁ}.) Nowadays? (\textbf{\ml{ഇക്കാലത്ത്}}, \emph{ikkālattŭ}.) On that day? (\textbf{\ml{അന്ന്}}, \emph{annŭ}.) Meanwhile? (\textbf{\ml{ഇതിനിടെ}}, \emph{itiniṭe}.) A bend? (\textbf{\ml{വളവ്}}, \emph{vaḷavŭ}.) A traffic signal? (\textbf{\ml{സിഗ്നൽ}}, \emph{signal}.) Traffic? (\textbf{\ml{ട്രാഫിക്}}, \emph{ṭrāphikŭ}.) A building? (\textbf{\ml{കെട്ടിടം}}, \emph{keṭṭiṭaṁ}.) A district? (\textbf{\ml{ജില്ല}}, \emph{jilla}.) A sports ground? (\textbf{\ml{മൈതാനം}}, \emph{maitānaṁ}.) A museum? (\textbf{\ml{മ്യൂസിയം}}, \emph{myūsiyaṁ}.) A gym? (\textbf{\ml{ജിം}}, \emph{jiṁ}.) A valley? (\textbf{\ml{താഴ്വര}}, \emph{tāḻvara}.) A desert? (\textbf{\ml{മരുഭൂമി}}, \emph{marubhūmi}.) A region? (\textbf{\ml{പ്രദേശം}}, \emph{pradēśaṁ}.) The land around a house? (\textbf{\ml{പറമ്പ്}}, \emph{paṟampŭ}.) A slope? (\textbf{\ml{ചരിവ്}}, \emph{carivŭ}.) A sacred grove? (\textbf{\ml{കാവ്}}, \emph{kāvŭ}.) A lane? (\textbf{\ml{ഇടവഴി}}, \emph{iṭavaḻi}.) Moreover? (\textbf{\ml{മാത്രമല്ല}}, \emph{mātramalla}.) Besides? (\textbf{\ml{കൂടാതെ}}, \emph{kūṭāte}.) For example? (\textbf{\ml{ഉദാഹരണത്തിന്}}, \emph{udāharaṇattinŭ}.) That is? (\textbf{\ml{അതായത്}}, \emph{atāyatŭ}.) Especially? (\textbf{\ml{പ്രത്യേകിച്ച്}}, \emph{pratyēkiccŭ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
